questions.question: Who made the obelisk, and what does its inscription say?
What future quest and reward involve the obelisk?

description:
Below the southern coast road, fishermen live with hooks, nets, stolen bait and a tended berry tree. Psyduck wanders by the bank. A concealed western path and an island obelisk give the place edges beyond its ordinary work; the obelisk is not yet explained.

Proposed bank routine: bait is kept in lidded boxes weighted with stones after repeated Aipom thefts. A clean landing beside the tree is kept clear of discarded hooks; the muddier feeding edge belongs to the creatures until somebody needs to land a boat. Help can mean collecting abandoned line or moving a dropped bait box, with the resulting clear patch still visible on a later visit. Optional battles are invitations away from the line-tending work, not the price of using the bank. None of this explains the obelisk or makes an ordinary fish catch into a relic.

sections: §32: pond, fishermen, relocated Psyduck and unresolved obelisk.

name: The pond below the South Coast Road
